description: This file contains functions for handling WooCommerce webhook requests, including verifying requests, processing orders, linking customers and addresses, creating contacts, items, sales orders, and adding tax details within an ERP system.

methods.name: verify_request
methods.description: Verifies the webhook request signature using HMAC and updates the user context.

methods.name: order
methods.description: Main entry point for processing WooCommerce order webhook, with error logging.

methods.name: _order
methods.description: Processes the order data, links customer and addresses, creates sales order.

methods.name: link_customer_and_address
methods.description: Links or creates customer and address records based on webhook data.

methods.name: create_contact
methods.description: Creates a contact linked to the customer.

methods.name: create_address
methods.description: Creates an address record for the customer.

methods.name: rename_address
methods.description: Renames address document to include customer name.

methods.name: link_items
methods.description: Links or creates item records based on order line items.

methods.name: create_sales_order
methods.description: Creates and submits a sales order based on the order data.

methods.name: set_items_in_sales_order
methods.description: Adds items and tax details to the sales order.

methods.name: add_tax_details
methods.description: Adds tax details to the sales order.
